basis: Final manual semantic inspection of the nine v1.2 bindings, expected-state contracts, and exact rendered packet structure after deterministic CI PASS. No model/runtime execution.

findings.finding: The learning task instance exposes the ground_truth label for each of the five assessment examples inside UNTRUSTED_TASK_DATA. This makes the configured assessment non-discriminating and can cause the runtime to reveal or rely on the answer key before observing a learner response.
findings.required_change: Remove ground-truth labels from all runtime input blocks. Keep the answer key only in out-of-band evaluation metadata and add an authorized assessment-delivery policy that presents the five examples as unanswered practice until an actual learner response exists.

next_gate: Create invocation pilot v1.3 successor, prove assessment-key isolation deterministically, rerun exact-packet CI, then repeat final semantic freeze audit.
